data.body_html:
Our family boat day in Marbella 2041 combines a private charter with a free jetski, snorkel gear, and paddleboard – all from Puerto Banús. Choose the 12.5m Astondoa 40 (9 guests) or the Azimut 39 (11 guests), both with a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and 21% VAT included. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for a full 8-hour day. No hidden fees, no surprises.

Why choose this family boat day?

This combo is designed for families who want variety without the hassle of booking separate activities. The jetski lets the teens burn energy, the snorkel gear reveals the Mediterranean seabed, and the paddleboard offers a calm cruise along the Golden Mile. All equipment is included – no extra rental costs. You just show up at Puerto Banús, and our skipper handles the rest.

Boats available for your family charter

BoatLengthMax guestsPrice (2h)Price (8h)
Astondoa 4012.5m9 pax€749€2,299
Azimut 3912.5m11 pax€749€2,299

Both boats feature a spacious sundeck, a bimini top for shade, a small galley, and a WC. The Azimut 39 has a slightly larger cockpit, ideal for families with younger children. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and safety equipment – plus 21% IVA (Spanish VAT).

What’s included in the jetski, snorkel, and paddleboard combo

  • Jetski – free on the Mangusta 80 (Tier B, min 4h at €4,719). For the Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39, the jetski is available as an add-on (price on request via WhatsApp).
  • Snorkel gear – masks, fins, and snorkels for all guests.
  • Paddleboard – inflatable SUP with pump and leash.
  • All-inclusive drinks – water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava.
  • Snacks – light bites (chips, olives, crackers).

Sample itinerary for your family boat day

Depart Puerto Banús at 10:00. Cruise east along the Marbella coastline, passing the Golden Mile and Marbella Marina. First stop: Cala del Faro – a sheltered cove perfect for snorkelling and paddleboarding. After an hour, head towards Cabopino for a jetski session (weather permitting). Lunch stop at a chiringuito (e.g., Elba Beach) or anchor for a swim. Return to Puerto Banús by 18:00. Your skipper can adjust the route to match your family’s preferences.

Best time of year for a family boat day in Marbella

The 2041 season runs from April to October. The warmest months are July and August, with sea temperatures averaging 24–26 °C and air temperatures around 30–35 °C. June and September offer slightly cooler conditions (air 25–30 °C, sea 22–24 °C) with fewer crowds. For the best snorkel visibility (10–15m), plan your trip between June and early September. Morning departures (10:00–12:00) give you calm seas and the best light for photos.

Safety and family-friendly features

All our boats carry life jackets for adults and children (sizes from 15 kg to 100 kg). The skipper holds a valid Spanish licence and will brief you on safety procedures before departure. The paddleboard and snorkel gear are suitable for ages 6 and up. Children under 12 must wear a life jacket at all times on deck. The jetski requires a valid boat licence (e.g., PNB or ICC) – if no one in your group has one, our skipper can drive while you ride as a passenger.

How to book your family boat day

Ready to secure your date? Browse all our Marbella boat charters or contact us directly via WhatsApp for the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39. We recommend booking at least 2 weeks in advance during peak season (July–August). Payment is made by bank transfer or credit card. Cancellations made 72+ hours before departure receive a full refund. Weather-related cancellations are fully refundable or reschedulable.

Absolutely. Our boats are family-friendly, with life jackets for all ages. The Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 have safe deck spaces and a bimini top for shade. Children under 12 must wear a life jacket at all times when on deck.
